requirement_text: The Faculty of Social Sciences has 'blended' pre-master's programmes, which make it possible to follow a pre-master's next to your job (with the exception of the pre-master Communicatiewetenschap, Dutch-taught). The education for these pre-master's programmes is partly online and the lectures take place on a fixed day in the week (Friday). The study load of the pre-master Communicatiewetenschap is spread over half a year (February - June). The lectures are spread over the whole week (Monday to Friday).
scope: Faculty of Social Sciences pre-master's programmes (e.g. Archeology, Political Science, Social and Cultural Anthropology, and several Dutch-taught tracks).
source_authority_note: vu.nl fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: NAMED EXCLUSION: the Communicatiewetenschap Pre-Master's is explicitly carved out of the 'blended, can work alongside it' pattern that otherwise applies to this faculty's other pre-master's tracks — it runs full-week, compressed into February-June instead.

scope: Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences pre-master's tracks.

requirement_text: If you do not meet the admission requirements, the following options are advised: Start your academic studies at an accredited university in your home country and obtain relevant credits; Have a look at a University of Applied Sciences; Apply for the VASVU foundation year. You will need a basic level of Dutch to start this programme, as VASVU courses are o[ffered in Dutch]; In some cases, it is possible to resolve your deficiencies by passing the relevant entrance examinations at Dutch pre-university level.
scope: Alternative pathways for Bachelor's applicants who do not directly meet VU's general admission requirements.
source_authority_note: vu.nl fails looksOfficial() (no .edu/.ac./.gov suffix) — this is the institution's own official page. Needs the officialDomains-provenance fix documented in source-authority-gap.md, not a lowered evidence bar.
limitations: Several list items were rendered with mid-sentence truncation in extraction (e.g. the VASVU line); combined into a summary rather than presented as verbatim quotation.
researcher_notes: VASVU (foundation year) specifically requires 'a basic level of Dutch' even though it exists to help international students reach Dutch admission standards — worth flagging since a student might otherwise assume a foundation year is English-medium.

requirement_text: You have the right to be admitted if you meet the admission requirements for the study programme AND submit your first enrolment application through Studielink on or before 1 May. NB: for some study programmes, you need to complete a mandatory study choice check. If you fail to take part, you will lose your right to be admitted. An educational institution may refuse to enrol you if you submit your first enrolment application through Studielink after the 1 May deadline.
scope: Nationwide Dutch statutory rule governing all non-numerus-fixus Bachelor's programmes, including VU Amsterdam's.
source_authority_note: Official application system. Per coordination DECISION 1 (2026-08-21, documented in source-authority-gap.md), an application system is HIGH authority for facts it owns — Studielink's 1 May national deadline and 'right to be admitted' framework is Dutch statute. Not authoritative for programme-specific facts a university sets itself.
limitations: No year stated anywhere on this Studielink page. Do not assume a specific year for the underlying 1 May deadline this right is conditioned on.
researcher_notes: Directly corroborates VU's own 'VU Study Choice Check' step in its Bachelor's application procedure (REQ0005) — the mandatory-check consequence is a national rule, not a VU invention.
